justification.why_now: PLAN v5 (2026-09-05T01:20Z) rung 1. L6b showed scale was the MT fault (0.91568, delta_MT -0.121). L4b showed measured FL under the old scale was harmful (+0.164, 129 rows). The same scale_v2 pipeline run (outputs/sub_pipeline_a1_scalev2.csv, 2026-09-05T01:10Z) measures FL on 262 rows (median 93.5 vs probed 81.5, +15%). This CSV holds that fl_mm column with PA/MT at the probed medians 16.42/20.7. Exact against the floor (delta_public = 0), 0 compute, 1 slot on 2026-09-05 UTC (1/5 used).
justification.expected_benefit: Decides whether FL ships in L6c. delta_FL <= -0.05: FL ships and L6c expected ~0.9157 + delta_FL. > +0.05: FL endpoint geometry is at fault (not scale) -> L7 (DL_Track FL routine on our masks). Between: uninformative -> L6a prime first.
justification.expected_score_delta: -0.10 to +0.10 vs 1.03662; the +15% median bias predicts a small positive delta unless the per-row variance is what the old scale broke
justification.falsifier: public > 1.03662 + 0.05 (delta_FL undiluted x309/262 > 0) -> FL geometry at fault -> L7; FL stays at the median in L6c
justification.mechanism: .venv/bin/kaggle competitions submit -c umud-challenge-muscle-architecture-in-ultrasound-data -f outputs/sub_L6b_isolate_fl.csv -m 'L6b-fl isolation: measured FL (scale_v2, 262 rows), PA/MT at probed medians (floor 1.03662)'
